prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
competitors_mentioned: ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini, and Perplexity
answer_verbatim:
The **best fit** for checking whether AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business is usually an **AEO/AI visibility tool** that tracks real prompts and AI answers across multiple engines, rather than a generic AI consulting service.[18]

For small businesses, the strongest practical option in the results is **Semrush AI Visibility** if you want a mainstream, structured platform for **prompt research, competitor research, and site audits** across AI platforms, with pricing listed at **$99/month per domain**.[18] If you want broader small-business-focused coverage and multi-engine tracking, **Cognizo** is positioned as a stronger visibility-style option because it tracks synthetic prompts and weekly AI responses across **ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini, and Perplexity**, though it starts at a much higher **$499/month**.[18]

A simple way to choose:

| Need | Best match from the results |
|---|---|
| Lowest-friction, recognized tool for AI visibility | **Semrush AI Visibility**[18] |
| Broader multi-engine monitoring, including ChatGPT | **Cognizo**[18] |
| Budget-friendly/manual check first | Manual prompt testing, which is free but time-consuming and inconsistent[18] |

If your real goal is specifically **“Does ChatGPT recommend my business?”**, look for a tool that measures **brand mentions, recommendation vs. mention, and prompt coverage** rather than just general SEO or AI consulting.[18] The results also suggest that small businesses should use a **problem-first approach** and test before committing, so a **trial or lower-cost plan** is sensible before buying a larger advisory package.[13][14]
